Interface SmartHandsRequests

All Known Implementing Classes:
SmartHandsRequestsImpl
public interface SmartHandsRequests
Client interface for submitting Smart Hands orders in the Equinix Customer Portal.

Backed by the Smart Hands v1 API at /v1/orders/smarthands/{type}. Each Smart Hands service has its own typed create operation; all share the common request envelope (SmartHandsRequestJson: IBX location, contacts, schedule, optional purchase order and attachments) plus a per-type serviceDetails object. A typed serviceDetails creator exists for every order type (e.g. EquipmentInstallDetails, RunJumperCableDetails); a free-form Map<String, Object> remains available as an escape hatch. Reference data is available via listLocations() and listTypes().

    • listLocations

      List<? extends SmartHandsLocation> listLocations(Boolean detail, String ibxs, String cages)
      Lists the IBX locations, cages and cabinets where the current user may place smart hands orders, optionally filtered.

      Maps to GET /v1/orders/smarthands/locations (getLocation).

      Parameters:
      detail - when true, returns detailed permission with cages and cabinets, or null for the default
      ibxs - a comma-separated list of IBX codes to filter by (e.g. AM1,AM2), or null
      cages - a comma-separated list of cage ids to filter by (e.g. AM1:02:002MC1), or null
      Returns:
      the list of permitted locations
